articles.title: One Penguin Group Stays Steady While Its Neighbor Shrinks
articles.summary: One group of rare penguins has stayed steady for 25 years while its neighbor has shrunk by more than 40 percent — and scientists are working out why.

articles.title: A Dead Star Spins Every 8 Minutes and Sends Mystery Radio Signals
articles.summary: A dead star spinning every eight minutes sends mystery radio signals from a system with a Sun-like companion — the first of its kind ever found.

articles.title: A Gentle Sound May Help the Brain Clean Itself at Night
articles.summary: MIT researchers found that precisely timed bursts of pink noise during sleep strengthen the brain waves that drive its nighttime cleaning fluid.
